Synthetic GridAtlas sample. Authored by hand for the acceptance case.
No random seed. These rows are not a measurement of any real grid.

SYN-NORTH installed nameplate is GEN-N-1 at 100 MW counted once, plus GEN-N-2 at 20 MW.
The second GEN-N-1 row is a duplicate.

SYN-NORTH queue is Q-20 at 20 MW counted once, plus Q-30 at 30 MW.
The second Q-20 row is a duplicate. Q-AMB lists 10 MW and 25 MW, so that request is excluded.
Q-99 is withdrawn. Q-77 is omitted. Headroom is not computed.

SYN-CENTRAL installed nameplate is an explicit reported zero.
SYN-CENTRAL queue was released on 2025-01-01 and is stale at the demo as-of date 2026-06-01.

SYN-SOUTH has no installed-nameplate manifest row, so that cell is missing rather than zero.
SYN-SOUTH queue is labeled MVA and must not be summed as MW.
